skills.name: imagegen
skills.description: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas.

interface.shortDescription: Generate or edit images for websites, games, and more
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $imagegen to make or edit an image for this project.

skills.name: openai-docs
skills.description: Use for Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, customization, automations, and self-knowledge—including 'you,' 'your,' 'this app,' or 'this coding agent' when they refer to Codex—and for OpenAI APIs/products and ChatGPT Work. skills.shortDescription: Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, and self-knowledge; OpenAI APIs and ChatGPT Work. 'You'/'this app' means Codex only.

interface.shortDescription: OpenAI and Codex docs for models, skills, tasks, and setup

skills.name: review-agent

interface.defaultPrompt: Use $review-agent to review the requested code changes and return actionable findings.

data.name: Codex Document Control
data.description: Use Codex Document Control to find connected document sessions, inspect the tools supported by a selected session, and execute one supported tool against that session. Call `list_document_sessions` first to choose the intended connected session, call `get_document_tool_schemas` before constructing tool arguments, then call `execute_document_command` with a caller-stable `idempotency_key`. Use this only for connected Codex document control; do not use it for general spreadsheet, presentation, or document tasks without a connected document session.
